what_it_supports: Direction and magnitude of a tumour-versus-normal RNA-expression association in the frozen TCGA-LUAD cohort.
what_it_does_not_support: Biological causality, cancer-cell dependency, therapeutic mechanism, drug efficacy, or intervention direction.
additional_evidence_required: Independent LUAD expression replication plus genetic or controlled perturbational evidence for causal interpretation.
provenance_requirement: Cohort definition|gene annotation|count processing|design and contrast|effect estimate|analysis commit
dependency_warning: Shares the TCGA cohort and primary model with significance statistics; S1-S6 are related reanalyses, not independent replication.

what_it_supports: Statistical evidence against the fitted model's null contrast after its stated multiple-testing procedure.
what_it_does_not_support: Biological importance, effect magnitude, causality, replication, druggability, or clinical relevance.
additional_evidence_required: Effect magnitude, model diagnostics, independent replication, and mechanistic evidence.
provenance_requirement: Cohort and design|contrast|test procedure|multiple-testing method|tested gene universe|analysis commit
dependency_warning: Derived from the same samples and model as the effect estimate; significance and effect are complementary fields, not separate votes.

what_it_supports: Sensitivity of the TCGA-LUAD expression result to prespecified related model specifications.
what_it_does_not_support: Independent biological replication, absence of bias, causality, efficacy, or clinical robustness.
additional_evidence_required: Independent-cohort replication and orthogonal biological validation.
provenance_requirement: Shared frozen cohort|S0-S6 model definitions|contrast consistency|residual degrees of freedom|analysis commits
dependency_warning: All robustness models reuse the same frozen expression cohort and cannot be counted as independent datasets.

what_it_supports: A source-native Open Targets association view directly linked to the LUAD disease identifier.
what_it_does_not_support: Causality, record independence, intervention efficacy, direction of action, or clinical validity.
additional_evidence_required: Datasource-level association records with upstream lineage plus independent genetic or functional evidence.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|LUAD disease ID|query|datasource records|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: May reuse literature, genetics, clinical, or ChEMBL-derived records and overlaps the indirect association view.

what_it_supports: An ontology-expanded Open Targets association view involving LUAD-related descendant disease records.
what_it_does_not_support: A direct LUAD association, an independent validation of the direct view, causality, or therapeutic relevance.
additional_evidence_required: Direct disease-specific records and review of descendant disease relevance and upstream record overlap.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|disease ontology path|descendant IDs|source records|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Derived from the same platform framework as the direct view and contains overlapping disease evidence.

what_it_supports: The number of literature occurrences returned by the defined Open Targets bibliography query.
what_it_does_not_support: Evidence quality, causal support, novelty, independent replication, or therapeutic value.
additional_evidence_required: Publication-level records with study design, claim relevance, duplication, and source-lineage review.
provenance_requirement: Platform release/API|query scope|filter definition|publication identifiers|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Literature occurrences may overlap association records and may contain multiple reports of the same underlying observation.

what_it_supports: A future source-grounded relationship between inherited or tumour-acquired genetic alteration and LUAD biology.
what_it_does_not_support: Pharmacological tractability, therapeutic direction, efficacy, or equivalence between genetic loss and drug modulation.
additional_evidence_required: Variant-level QC, independent cohorts, functional perturbation, mechanism, and pharmacological validation.
provenance_requirement: Source release|cohort|alteration and gene identifiers|disease definition|statistical model|sample overlap
dependency_warning: Future genetic evidence may share TCGA samples or may already contribute to Open Targets association evidence.

what_it_supports: A future context-specific effect of gene perturbation on cancer-model fitness or function.
what_it_does_not_support: Patient benefit, universal tumour dependency, safe therapeutic window, drug efficacy, or clinical relevance.
additional_evidence_required: Independent screens, LUAD model coverage, rescue/orthogonal perturbation, in-vivo context, and normal-cell comparison.
provenance_requirement: Screen release|model and lineage|guide reagents|QC metrics|effect definition|replicate structure
dependency_warning: Models, guides, or upstream screens can be reused across resources; lineage independence requires record-level review.

what_it_supports: The presence and annotation of a target entity in the frozen ChEMBL release.
what_it_does_not_support: Compound binding, potency, selectivity, mechanism, LUAD relevance, tractability, or clinical actionability.
additional_evidence_required: Assay- and compound-level activity records with target confidence, potency, mechanism, and selectivity context.
provenance_requirement: ChEMBL release|target ID|mapping basis|target type|annotation record|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Open Targets drug and tractability records may reuse ChEMBL target or compound information.

what_it_supports: The source-native count of Open Targets drug or clinical-candidate records linked to the target query.
what_it_does_not_support: Compound quality, unique mechanisms, target validity, disease-specific efficacy, approval, or independent support.
additional_evidence_required: Record-level compounds, mechanisms, indications, phases, statuses, target linkage, and upstream-source deduplication.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|record identifiers|count definition|query|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Records may overlap ChEMBL and Open Targets tractability or clinical-precedence evidence.

what_it_supports: A future source-grounded compound-target assay or mechanism observation at defined target confidence and activity context.
what_it_does_not_support: In-vivo efficacy, selectivity across biology, LUAD relevance, clinical benefit, or safety.
additional_evidence_required: Potency normalization, assay quality, selectivity panels, mechanism, target engagement, disease models, and exposure evidence.
provenance_requirement: ChEMBL release|compound/target/assay IDs|target confidence|activity type/value/unit|mechanism record
dependency_warning: Compound records can be upstream of Open Targets drug and small-molecule tractability evidence.

what_it_supports: A source-native Open Targets assessment of small-molecule tractability for the target.
what_it_does_not_support: Biological causality, compound efficacy, selectivity, disease relevance, safety, or development success.
additional_evidence_required: Bucket-level provenance, structural/ligand evidence, selective compounds, target engagement, and disease-model validation.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|modality|assessment and bucket identifiers|upstream evidence
dependency_warning: Shares the Open Targets tractability framework and may reuse ChEMBL or clinical-precedence records.

what_it_supports: A source-native Open Targets assessment of antibody tractability for the target.
what_it_does_not_support: Target accessibility in the relevant tumour, antibody efficacy, selectivity, safety, or clinical success.
additional_evidence_required: Cell-surface/accessibility evidence, target localization, antibody specificity, functional studies, and exposure context.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|antibody modality|assessment/bucket identifiers|upstream evidence
dependency_warning: Shares the Open Targets framework and can overlap platform drug/candidate clinical precedent.

what_it_supports: A source-native Open Targets assessment of PROTAC or targeted-protein-degradation tractability.
what_it_does_not_support: Degrader efficacy, ternary-complex formation, suitable tissue exposure, biological validity, safety, or clinical success.
additional_evidence_required: Ligand and E3 compatibility, degradation assays, selectivity, target resynthesis, disease-model response, and exposure evidence.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|degrader modality|assessment/bucket identifiers|upstream evidence
dependency_warning: Shares source framework and may reuse ligandability or development-precedence records represented elsewhere.

what_it_supports: A source-native Open Targets assessment for another clinically precedented modality category.
what_it_does_not_support: Feasibility of a specific unnamed modality, biological causality, efficacy, safety, or clinical success.
additional_evidence_required: Explicit modality identity, mechanism, target-access evidence, product-level precedent, and disease-context validation.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|explicit modality category|assessment/bucket identifiers|upstream evidence
dependency_warning: Other-clinical-modality assessments may encode clinical precedent also represented in drug or trial records.

what_it_supports: A future trial-level record that target modulation or a linked intervention entered human investigation in a defined disease context.
what_it_does_not_support: Efficacy, target validity, approval, successful completion, patient benefit, or a favorable benefit-risk balance.
additional_evidence_required: Verified intervention-target linkage, trial status/phase, disease relevance, results, endpoints, exposure, and safety outcomes.
provenance_requirement: Registry and version|trial ID|intervention ID|target-linkage basis|disease ID|phase/status|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Trial records may overlap Open Targets candidate counts and tractability clinical-precedence assessments.

what_it_supports: A curated Open Targets safety-liability observation with its reported context and source lineage.
what_it_does_not_support: Causal on-target toxicity, incidence, dose relationship, complete risk, target rejection, or safety when records are absent.
additional_evidence_required: Record-level on/off-target attribution, exposure, normal-tissue expression, essentiality, toxicology, clinical outcomes, and replication.
provenance_requirement: Open Targets release/API|target ID|liability and datasource IDs|study/publication|context|retrieval timestamp
dependency_warning: Multiple liability records may share a datasource, study, publication, event, compound, or mechanism.
